name: Production Showcase
description: Every new production machine on one floor, stocked and wired: read the signs, press Start, send the bill. Set it on flat ground: it is 94 by 22 m, and a slope through the back strip buries the panel line's Extruder.

text: MAIN SWITCH: off = machines No power, genset and lamps off
STOCK: creative fills these bins; survival builds them empty
SMELTER: Hearth Blocks in squares; bigger squares pay more
SAWMILL: Saw Blocks in squares; bigger squares pay more
FOUNDRY: Crucible Blocks in squares; bigger squares pay more
Press Start on the console: all three refiners run
Cut this conveyor to see pieces drop
Line A's angles go in here: the press stamps brackets
Take a piece with F (aim at the one you want)
Line B (planks) meets line A at the join: one rack
Too narrow on purpose: aim the linking tool, wheel to widen
Narrow this conveyor (linking tool, wheel): a refusal
ROUTER: ordered parts ride to the tray, the rest to the rack
Aim at the Router: it names where each piece goes
Send the bill: the Assembler makes these parts
Bill, then Send: the orders go out. Then Line, Start
F on the screen: order a part. It arrives in the tray
F on the station: pick Swing Arm Buggy, Start
PANELS: a blank in at the white end, a panel out the orange
Send the bill: a hood, a fender and a kit hood are formed
F: design a panel; it is formed next door
ORDER A CLUTCH: THIS ASSEMBLER MAKES ITS GEAR SET
GROW FORMER: order a wing; it grows east, then drops
LASER CUTTER: press Start on the orders console, then order
BRIDGE CRANE: die, press, pad. F on its cabinet: orders
SCRAP BREAKER: drop wrecks on any square; big squares pay
KEEP CLEAR of the rotors while it works
MONITOR: the console's Data out wired to a display
MONITOR: any display works; it lays itself out
ORDERS BOARD: red lamp = Alarm (a machine waits or is out)
NETWORK BOARD
